items.title: Memory can cross the wrong boundary
items.fact: A synthetic-profile benchmark reports inappropriate disclosure of remembered information in tested systems.
items.signal: Interpretation: retrieval quality and appropriate information flow need separate tests.

reads.text: Check task scope before using remembered context.
Care for a neighbor includes care with what has been entrusted to us.
Benchmark findings do not validate this site’s design or establish a real-world harm rate.

items.source: Fang et al. · revised research preprint
items.title: Attachment questions need careful evidence
items.fact: The revised four-week study found no significant assigned-condition effects; heavier voluntary use was associated with worse psychosocial outcomes.
items.signal: Interpretation: design and use patterns deserve study without reducing wellbeing to time-on-device.

reads.text: Which relationships and practices does this use support or displace?
Prayer, Scripture and human community remain practices worth protecting.
Association with voluntary use is not proof of causation or a diagnosis of a reader.

items.title: Capability needs accountable use
items.fact: NIST published a generative-AI companion profile to its AI Risk Management Framework.
items.signal: Interpretation: oversight needs explicit responsibilities, evidence and evaluation, not confidence alone.

reads.text: Keep the responsible person and the limits of the system visible.
What can someone inspect, contest, correct or stop?
A framework is guidance, not certification or a prediction about the future.
